tempest

STORM & Co-STORM research agents for R

Research that checks its sources
and remembers what your team reviewed.

Tempest runs multi-perspective research workflows in R, verifies every claim against exact source quotes, pairs reports with reproducible R analyses, and connects to graft so reviewed findings carry cleanly into your next session, app, or MCP client.

Get started Research that remembers with Graft Read a live report

How Tempest works

Step 1

Investigate from multiple angles

Run a scripted STORM pipeline or hold an interactive Co-STORM panel discussion. Specialists search the web, your ragnar store, host R tools, or MCP servers.

Step 2

Verify claims & run analyses

Every claim is checked against an exact source span. Optionally add scientific claim review, targeted evidence repair, reproducible R computations, and conceptual illustrations.

Step 3

Review & remember with Graft

Nothing becomes organizational knowledge automatically. Review reports in the app, explicitly accept or withdraw streams in graft, and let future agents consult only what is currently approved.

Quick start in R 

library(tempest)

# 1. Run a scripted STORM report
cfg <- tempest_config(
  models = "openai/gpt-5.6-luna",
  search_provider = "wikipedia"
)
result <- tempest_run(
  "Technical and policy barriers to grid-scale battery recycling",
  config = cfg,
  n_experts = 2,
  max_questions_per_perspective = 2
)

cat(tempest_report(result))
tempest_claims(result)
tempest_claim_supports(result)

Or launch the Researcher app with a persistent report library and Graft project memory:

tempest_researcher_app(
  output_dir = "research-reports",
  report_library = TRUE,
  graft_store = "research-memory"
)

Choose your interactive app

Researcher app

Draft or pick a starter brief, attach host R tools or MCP servers, run optional R analyses, browse saved reports, and accept findings into Graft.

tempest_researcher_app(graft_store = “memory”)

Co-STORM workspace

Explore an open-ended question interactively with a panel of experts, live mind map, evidence tables, shinychat memory cards, and report publishing.

tempest_app(graft_store = “memory”)

Offline ecosystem demo

Try real deputy, dsprrr, shinymcp, and graft execution locally with zero API keys or network calls—accept, correct, withdraw, and reopen exact evidence.

tempest_app(demo = TRUE)

Tempest in the ellmer ecosystem

Tempest focuses on scientific research, claim-centered evidence, and reports, delegating horizontal concerns to companion packages:

Package Role How it pairs with Tempest
ellmer & shinychat LLM calls, tools, and streaming chat UI Drives every model role and renders interactive Co-STORM conversations and reviewed-memory tool cards
deputy Permission-bounded agent runtime Runs moderator and expert sessions with explicit tool allowlists and terminal execution traces
dsprrr Typed structured language programs Executes structured stages (perspectives, claim extraction, verification, outline, writing)
graft Reviewed project memory & persistent artifacts Stores immutable research candidates, explicit human accept/withdraw decisions, and multi-stream recall tools (graft_tools())
ragnar Chunking & semantic retrieval (RAG) Finds candidate passages across large corpora; pair with Graft so ragnar finds and graft verifies
shinymcp & mcptools MCP Apps & MCP tool servers Inspect completed research in read-only cards (tempest_mcp_app()) and serve reviewed Graft streams to IDE agents
scans & vitals Trajectory inspection & evaluation Audit completed trajectories and @extra$graft consultations with scans; evaluate models offline with vitals
